Also, I came to realise that boxing is an excellent way to get to know myself. I started to understand more about how my brain works and reacts which helped me improve mentally in every way, from thinking clearly in intense situations to breathing, balancing and sharpening my reflexes. As you begin learning how to stay balanced in boxing, subconsciously you also begin learning how to balance yourself better in life.

Technically stronger - If you find some other classes do not emphasise technique, every class at STRONGER BOXING is guaranteed to not only make you work hard but also leave you with a greater understanding of the sweet science. Boxing is a lot more strategic than simply throwing random punches and STRONGER BOXING is heavily focused on the technical side. Jason is so thorough in explaining and always shares valuable fight tactics and boxing strategies that will help you become much more intelligent and skillful in order to be a stronger, smarter fighter.

Great training environment for all levels – The people in our Sunday group classes are so friendly and welcoming. I am a big introvert but from day 1, I have never felt intimidated by the group. More importantly the coach adjusts his training to accommodate for all levels, no matter if you are a corporate person who have never thrown a punch or if you are an experienced boxer. Each session is very well thought out and cleverly designed. Jason clearly puts a lot of time and dedication into designing these sessions which are full of variety and lots of fun.

A professional coach that will look after you – Jason is so passionate, patient, and accommodating. Even in the group classes where there are so many trainees, he always pays close attention to each person and never makes them feel left out. He is also extremely knowledgeable on how our bodies work. Most importantly while he motivates me to push myself hard, he also ensures that my technique is always correct to avoid any injuries.

If I could give you 10 Stars, I would!
Muay Thai was something that my 16 year old son, Josh had discovered and quietly researched on his own in the past two years. He had tried out a few martial art forms in the past but lost interest simply because he was not inspired, he needed more than just step by step learning.
He needed Authenticity and a Kind environment! And our family Moto has always been, ‘If it’s Not Fun or Kind, Don’t do it’!!!

After reading up about some of the coaches inspiring journeys with Muay Thai Camps, Josh was convinced MSP Gym would be the authentic experience that he has been searching for years.

But more than authenticity, kind environment and sound disciplines, Josh also felt a huge sense of respect everyone has for the coaches and vice versa which further encouraged him to sign up as a member.

Josh felt extremely welcomed from the moment he stepped on the mat on his first class few weeks ago. He is enjoying his learning from Mardsing, Wut and Ang, he appreciates their attention to detail and patient guidance to suit his individual needs.

Chantelle, Thank you kindly for speaking to me on the phone with such patience, your kind assistance was part of why I encouraged Josh to have his first visit.

Thank you all for holding a safe and inspiring space for Josh to learn his new found martial art form/sport.
The joy on Josh’s face after each class is enough for us to drive all the way from the Blue Mountains twice a week.

10 Stars to you all!
🌟 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
With warmth and gratitude,

[{"Name":"Andrea H.","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV89iG0x_XzUaEQHTqIZdCV7PhFGds1kah6-Y_Nv-zVYmGs2avN=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The staff at this gym will outcare the competition -and that’s something you don’t find everyday. I started training here November 2024. I was in really bad shape and a complete beginner to Muay Thai and to the area. Thanks to Nicky and Paul’s training I advanced quickly and just a few months after joining I was confident enough to start sparring, which is totally optional. When I accidentally sprained my ankle during training and became homebound, I was touched beyond words when Nicky took time out of her schedule to come to my house and visit with goodies!! I had only been training there a couple of months but this small gesture spoke volumes. While recovering from my ankle sprain I had a
personalised training plan, and I didn’t have to pay extra. They offer a really nice range of classes which they will adapt to your needs no matter your fitness level or previous injuries.
